svg.title: Out Of Credits — Declarative .kiro Multi-Agent Orchestration
svg.desc: Animated diagram showing how a scenario typed into kiro-cli --agent lead-dev is routed declaratively via agents-build.mjs and .kiro/agents/ to the nine Kiro Crew specialists, verified by qa and 16 deterministic quality gates, and pushed to an agent branch.

g.text: "Rework Esc menu & HUD, keep Level 9 badge in stage, update SFX & run QA"

svg.text: STANDBY CREW SPECIALISTS + FINAL QA GATE
